plan.summary:
Adds a Retries section to the Requests guide. It explains the new `retries` option and shows TypeScript and Python examples in tabs.

- Imports the `Tabs` and `TabItem` theme components.
- Adds a "Retries" section with a `<Tabs>` block, one tab per language.
plan.riskRationale: Documentation-only change to one MDX guide. No runtime code is touched. The only technical risk is that the tab imports must resolve when the docs build.
plan.storyArc: The guide needs to show the `retries` option per language. The imports make the tab components available. The new section then uses them.

topics.title: Document the retries option with language tabs
topics.narrativeBrief: How does the guide present the `retries` option? Connect the new Tabs imports to the Retries section that uses them. Verify the TabItem values match the intended languages (ts, py).
